## Checklist

- [ ] `deno task test` and `deno task oss:check` pass
- [ ] The affected generator combinations pass `deno task check` (state which)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, stack README, `template/docs/`) and `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry
- [ ] Third-party code or assets are recorded in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` with a compatible licence
- [ ] No personal data, machine paths or private project names
